# Brennan Center for Justice

> > The Brennan Center for Justice at NYU Law works to build an America that is democratic, just, and free.

The Brennan Center is a nonpartisan law and policy institute focused on democracy, justice, and liberty. Led by experts like Michael Waldman, the Center conducts research, litigation, and advocacy on voting rights, criminal justice reform, judicial independence, and constitutional protections.

## Key Topics

- Voting Rights
- Election Security
- Felony Disenfranchisement
- Supreme Court Ethics
- State Courts
- Judicial Elections
- Civil Rights
- Criminal Justice Reform
- Florida Amendment 4
- Election Crimes
- Amicus Briefs
- Language Access
- Gerrymandering
- First Amendment
- Abortion Litigation

## Voting Rights & Election Integrity

- [Freedom to Vote Act Reintroduced in Congress; Brennan Center Reacts](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/analysis-opinion/freedom-vote-act-reintroduced-congress-brennan-center-reacts): Brennan Center statement on Freedom to Vote Act congressional reintroduction
- [The Responsibilities of Election Officials Regarding Access to Records and Equipment](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/research-reports/responsibilities-election-officials-regarding-access-records-and): Guidance for election officials on public records access and equipment
- [Voting and Civil Rights Groups Condemn Arrests of Floridians Captured on Video](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/analysis-opinion/voting-and-civil-rights-groups-condemn-arrests-floridians-captured-video): Analysis on Florida arrests of voters under Amendment 4 voting rights law
- [Voting and Civil Rights Organizations File Suit Over Florida's Flawed Voter Registration Form](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/analysis-opinion/voting-and-civil-rights-organizations-file-suit-over-floridas-flawed): League of Women Voters and NAACP lawsuit over Florida registration form
- [Governor DeSantis Signs Election Crimes Law Expanding Statewide Prosecutor's Power](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/analysis-opinion/governor-desantis-signs-election-crimes-law-expanding-statewide): Response to Florida SB 4B expanding prosecution of voters with convictions

## Court Cases & Legal Advocacy

- [Murthy v. Missouri (Formerly Missouri v. Biden)](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/court-cases/murthy-v-missouri-formerly-missouri-v-biden): First Amendment case on government speech and social media moderation
- [League of Women Voters of Utah v. Utah State Legislature (Amicus Brief)](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/court-cases/league-women-voters-utah-v-utah-state-legislature-amicus-brief): Amicus brief on Utah partisan gerrymandering case before state Supreme Court
- [State Court Abortion Litigation Tracker](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/research-reports/state-court-abortion-litigation-tracker): Tracker of post-Dobbs abortion litigation in state courts nationwide

## Judicial Independence & Ethics

- [What Gifts Must Supreme Court Justices Disclose?](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/research-reports/what-gifts-must-supreme-court-justices-disclose): Explainer on Supreme Court gift disclosure requirements and ethics rules
- [The Supermajority](https://www.brennancenter.org/events/supermajority): Book launch event for Michael Waldman's Supreme Court analysis
- [Buying Time 2008: Louisiana](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/research-reports/buying-time-2008-louisiana): 2008 Louisiana Supreme Court judicial election advertising analysis
- [Buying Time 2008: Nevada](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/research-reports/buying-time-2008-nevada): 2008 Nevada Supreme Court judicial election campaign advertising report

## Criminal Justice & Civil Liberties

- [Police Social Media Monitoring Chills Activism](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/analysis-opinion/police-social-media-monitoring-chills-activism): Analysis on police surveillance of climate activists via social media
- [Letter on the "Inmate Financial Responsibility Program: Procedures, Proposed Rule"](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/research-reports/letter-inmate-financial-responsibility-program-procedures-proposed-rule): Comment letter on federal Inmate Financial Responsibility Program rule

## Access to Justice

- [Selected Early Findings From a 50-State Study of Language Access in Civil State Court Proceedings](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/research-reports/selected-early-findings-50-state-study-language-access-civil-state-court): Early findings from 50-state study on civil court language access
